craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 21. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By which, as soon as seen — thus, from the two words 'siddha' and 'mātra': the form radiant in form, which, mantra like it very radiant.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ
